resources.string:
A quiet, fast, tvOS-inspired home for Android TV, plus the tools a TV actually needs: an app manager, a file manager, a debug guide and a browser with an ad blocker. Not affiliated with Apple.

Imagery (CC BY-SA 4.0, Wikimedia Commons):

• Zhuravlyne Lake, Ukraine — Medoffer
• Punjab, India — Bhullargraphic

No analytics, no ads, no background services.
A quiet home for your TV.\n\nUse the D-pad to move. Press OK to open. Hold OK for app options. The time in the corner opens Settings.
